'''Davo Sculdun's gallery''',<ref name="Databank" /> or the '''Sculdun Collection''',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> was a gallery of rare artifacts owned by the [[Chandrilan]] [[Davo Sculdun]]. It was located in [[Sculdun Tower|Sculdun's office]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Description==
Located at [[Davo Sculdun]]'s [[Sculdun Tower|office]] on [[Coruscant]], the gallery consisted of a large circular room separated from a surrounding walkway by arched pillars. Artifacts were displayed on separate pillars located in the center of the room.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==History==
Around [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Sell Date">In the episode, "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," [[Luthen Rael]] states that they only got bits and pieces of intel for two [[Standard year|years]], thus stating that the [[listening device]] they added to the Tinian Codex was installed two years early. Since the previous episode, "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," established that the events the episode take place during [[3 BBY]] then [[Davo Sculdun]] must have bought the item around [[5 BBY]].</ref> [[Luthen Rael]] sold the [[Tinian Codex]] to Sculdun with a [[listening device]] installed in the piece in order to gather intelligence for his [[Axis network|rebel operations]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>

In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Episode Date">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" established that the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" take place during [[3 BBY]].</ref> Sculdun discovered that a piece in his collection, the [[Coryio Chalice]] was a forgery and ordered his assistant [[Mishko]] to have his entire collection re-appraised following an upcoming a [[Davo Sculdun's party|party]] he was hosting for [[Senate Investiture]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> By the time of the party Sculdun had acquired a new piece, the [[Lost Tairn]]. At the same time his collection also consisted of a [[Carmeenian helmet]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

During the party, Sculdun invited a select group of party guest to tour the gallery. Two members of the group, [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] and [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] traded barbs while the group toured the gallery. At the same time, Rael's assistant [[Kleya Marki]] with the help [[Lonni Jung]], a rebel operative working undercover as [[ISB Supervisor]], was able to covertly use [[Kleya's brooch]] to remove the listening device from the Tinian Codex before the group arrived at it.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gallery appeared in the [[I Have Friends Everywhere|fifth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> It was later identified as Davo Sculdun’s gallery in a [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry posted to [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Databank" />
